title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star (3D Animated Nursery Rhyme)
prompt: Cute 3D animated toddler nursery rhyme, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, 10 scenes of 8 seconds each. Soft pastel colours, rounded glossy toy-like shapes, warm glowing light, big sparkly eyes, smooth gentle motion. Characters: Pip the cream bunny with floppy ears in sky-blue star pyjamas, Twinkle the smiling yellow star, Fox the friendly orange cub with lantern. Female lullaby vocal singing the rhyme, music box, glockenspiel, harp, 90 BPM.

characters.Pip: Cream baby bunny with floppy ears and sky-blue star pyjamas
characters.Twinkle: Smiling golden star with rosy cheeks and warm glow
characters.Fox: Friendly orange cub with bushy tail and wooden lantern

scenes.lyric: Twinkle, twinkle, little star, how I wonder what you are.
scenes.action: Pip sits on windowsill gazing at Twinkle, head tilting with floating sparkle

scenes.lyric: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky.
scenes.action: Pip floats happily on fluffy cloud through glittering diamond stars

scenes.lyric: When the sun has gone away, moon and stars come out to play.
scenes.action: Smiling sun waves goodbye setting behind green hills as Pip waves back

scenes.lyric: Then you shine your little light, twinkle softly through the night.
scenes.action: Pip does a joyful toddler sway dance among glowing flowers and fireflies

scenes.lyric: Then the traveller in the dark, thanks you for your tiny spark.
scenes.action: Fox walks along night forest path swinging his warm lantern, smiling up at Twinkle

scenes.lyric: He could not see which way to go, if you did not twinkle so.
scenes.action: Fox trots curiously down the sparkling stardust path illuminated by Twinkle

scenes.lyric: In the dark blue sky you keep, and often through my curtains peep.
scenes.action: Pip snuggles in cozy bed as Twinkle peeks through window curtains and winks

scenes.lyric: For you never shut your eye, till the sun is in the sky.
scenes.action: Twinkle watches sleepy village as sunrise arrives, giving a sleepy cute yawn

scenes.lyric: As your bright and tiny spark, lights the traveller in the dark.
scenes.action: Fox and Pip walk up the starry hill together to meet under Twinkle's light

scenes.lyric: Though I know not what you are, twinkle, twinkle, little star.
scenes.action: Pip, Fox and Twinkle wave goodbye together from cloud pulling back to cosmos
